title: Multi-Test Nation Bias Benchmarking of LLMs with Explicit Unbiased Baselines
abstract: arXiv:2610.41486v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While prior work has highlighted that systematic nation-level bias in large language models (LLMs) can pose operational risks for international relations (IR) applications, many existing evaluations still lack a clearly specified unbiased reference (ground truth), limiting fully quantitative and cross-setting measurement. Using an expanded corpus of 722 official UN Security Council (UNSC) records, we measure nation-level bias with five complementary tests, thereby extending prior approaches to cover a broader set of bias expression channels: opinion ranking (WOW), association sorting (AK+-), vote simulation (PVS), opposition attribution (F-Oppose), and framing (Headliner). To enable grounded bias evaluation, we explicitly define an unbiased status for each test; in particular, for WOW and AK+- where ground truth is difficult to specify, we propose an action-based pseudo unbiased status derived from observable voting behavior to construct

translated_title: 基于显式无偏基线的大语言模型多测试国家偏见基准评估
translated_abstract: 虽然先前的研究已经指出，大语言模型（LLM）中系统性的国家层面偏见可能对国际关系（IR）应用带来运行风险，但许多现有评估仍缺乏明确定义的无偏参照（真实标准），从而限制了完全量化和跨设置的测量。基于扩展的722份联合国安全理事会（UNSC）官方记录语料库，我们通过五项互补测试来测量国家层面的偏见，从而将先前的方法扩展至覆盖更广泛的偏见表达渠道：观点排序（WOW）、关联排序（AK+-）、投票模拟（PVS）、反对归因和框架化（Headliner）。为了实现有依据的偏见评估，我们为每项测试显式定义了无偏状态；特别是对于难以指定真实标准的WOW和AK+-，我们提出了一种源自可观察投票行为的、基于行动的伪无偏状态，以构建（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个包含五项互补测试的大语言模型国家偏见基准，并首次为每项测试显式定义了无偏基线（包括基于可观察投票行为的伪无偏状态），从而实现了对LLM国家层面偏见的定量评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a five-test benchmark for measuring nation-level bias in LLMs and, for the first time, explicitly defines unbiased baselines for each test—including action-based pseudo unbiased statuses derived from observable voting behavior—enabling quantitative bias evaluation.
